overview: U-MARVEL systematically explores design principles for training Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as embedding models for Universal Multimodal Retrieval, proposing a pipeline involving progressive transition, hard negative mining, and reranker distillation.

modules.name: Multimodal Data Preprocessing
modules.description: Handles the parsing, image transformation, and text tokenization for the M-BEIR dataset and other data sources, specifically formatting inputs with instructions and placeholders.

modules.name: Progressive Curriculum Data Manager
modules.description: Manages the sequential loading of datasets for the progressive transition strategy, switching between text-only, text-image pairs, and multimodal instruction data across training stages.

modules.name: MLLM Embedding Extractor
modules.description: Implements the decoder-only MLLM backbone with LoRA adaptation, modified to support bidirectional attention and feature extraction via masked mean pooling (excluding instruction tokens).

modules.name: Contrastive Learning Loss Engine
modules.description: Implements the InfoNCE loss function with support for learnable temperature parameters and score scaling logic required for contrastive embedding training.

modules.name: Hard Negative Mining Pipeline
modules.description: Offline pipeline that uses a pre-trained recall model to extract features, compute query-candidate similarities, filter out false negatives based on a similarity threshold, and sample the top-k hard negatives.

modules.name: Training Loop: Progressive Transition
modules.description: Orchestrates the first phase of training, managing the curriculum schedule and transitioning the model from text retrieval to cross-modal and then multimodal retrieval tasks.

modules.name: Training Loop: Hard Negative Fusion
modules.description: Manages the continual training phase, combining standard in-batch negatives with the pre-mined filtered hard negatives to improve the model's discriminative ability.

modules.name: Generative Reranker Model
modules.description: Implements the MLLM-based pointwise reranker architecture and its supervised fine-tuning loop, training the model to output relevance judgments based on query-candidate pairs.

modules.name: Recall-Rerank Inference Ensemble
modules.description: Implements the inference pipeline that retrieves candidates using the recall model and then rescores the top-k results using the generative reranker, combining scores via linear interpolation.

modules.name: Improved Distillation Pipeline
modules.description: Distills the knowledge of the ensemble recall-rerank pipeline into a single student embedding model using KL divergence, focusing the distillation loss on positive and hard negative samples to improve efficiency.

modules.name: M-BEIR Evaluation Engine
modules.description: Computes Recall metrics under both Local and Global pool settings for the M-BEIR benchmark, handling the separation of task-specific and universal candidate pools.

modules.name: Zero-Shot Generalization Tester
modules.description: Evaluates the trained embedding model on unseen cross-modal retrieval and video retrieval datasets to assess zero-shot transfer capabilities without task-specific fine-tuning.

modules.name: Ablation: Embedding Architecture
modules.description: Framework to compare different embedding extraction strategies, specifically comparing causal vs. bidirectional attention and last-token vs. mean-pooling mechanisms, as well as instruction masking effects.

modules.name: Ablation: Contrastive Recipe
modules.description: Framework to analyze the interaction effects between batch size scaling, learning rate adjustment, and temperature coefficient settings (fixed vs. learnable) on contrastive learning performance.

modules.name: Training Infrastructure & Utils
modules.description: Handles distributed training coordination, gradient accumulation, mixed precision support, logging, and model checkpointing throughout the multi-stage training process.
